name: BIS Product Certification Scheme (Scheme I - ISI Mark)
description: The third-party product certification scheme operated by BIS under Scheme I of Schedule II of the Bureau of Indian Standards (Conformity Assessment) Regulations, 2018. Confers the right to use the prestigious Standard Mark (ISI Mark) on manufactured products complying with relevant Indian Standards.
requirements: Factory audit of manufacturing infrastructure and quality control facilities
In-house testing laboratory equipped per BIS Scheme of Testing and Inspection (STI)
Independent sample drawing and third-party laboratory verification by BIS-recognized lab
Surveillance inspections and continuous product quality conformity

name: Compulsory Registration Scheme (CRS - Scheme II)
authority: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) & BIS
description: Registration scheme operated under Scheme II of Schedule II of BIS (Conformity Assessment) Regulations, 2018. Mandatory for notified electronic, electrical, and lighting products. Manufacturers obtain registration based on Self-Declaration of Conformity (SDoC) after testing in BIS-approved labs.
schemeType: Conformity Assessment Scheme II (Self-Declaration of Conformity)
applicableProducts: Fixed General Purpose LED Luminaires and Street Lights (IS 10322 Part 5 Sec 3)
Electronic Controlgear for LED Modules / LED Drivers (IS 15885 Part 2 Sec 13)
LED Modules for General Lighting (IS 16103 Part 1)
requirements: Product testing in BIS-recognized testing laboratory in India
Submission of complete test reports conforming to specified Indian Safety Standards
Affixing of BIS Standard Mark with unique R-number on product and packaging
Mandatory renewal and market surveillance sample picking

name: Electrical and Lighting Quality Control Orders (QCO)
authority: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT) / Ministry of Power
description: Statutory orders issued under Section 16 of the BIS Act, 2016, making compliance to specific Indian Standards and bearing of the Standard Mark mandatory for manufacture, import, sale, and public procurement of lighting and electrical products.
applicableProducts: Road and Street Lighting Luminaires (IS 10322 Part 5 Sec 3)
requirements: Valid BIS License or Registration before supply under government tenders
Traceable manufacturer R-number or CML license number marked on luminaire housing
Public procurement tenders require compliance proof as technical qualifying criteria

source.sourceName: DPIIT Technical Regulations / Gazette of India

name: Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) Quality Control Order
authority: Ministry of Commerce and Industry / DPIIT
description: Statutory Quality Control Order mandating that safety footwear, industrial safety helmets, and fall protection harnesses comply with corresponding Indian Standards and bear the ISI Mark under BIS Product Certification Scheme I.
requirements: Prohibition of manufacture, import, or supply without BIS ISI Mark
Periodic lot testing for shock absorption, drop test, and dielectric strength
Batch inspection certificates submitted with procurement consignments

source.sourceName: DPIIT Footwear and Protective Equipment Orders

name: BEE Standards & Labeling Program (Star Rating)
authority: Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE), Ministry of Power
description: Energy efficiency rating scheme providing energy performance grading (1 to 5 Stars) based on testing aligned with BIS standards (such as IS 16102 Part 2) to reduce energy consumption in lighting and appliances.
requirements: Testing of luminous efficacy (lm/W) in NABL/BEE accredited photometric laboratory
Filing of registration with BEE portal and affixing of Star Rating Label
Specified minimum efficiency thresholds mandated in public smart city and municipal street lighting tenders

name: Scheme of Testing and Inspection (STI)
description: Prescribed factory internal quality assurance document issued by BIS for every licensed standard. Outlines the precise testing schedule, sampling frequencies, records maintenance, and rejection criteria that licensees must adhere to maintain the ISI Mark.
requirements: Continuous logging of routine and acceptance test results per STI schedule
Calibrated measuring apparatus and valid calibration certificates
Strict lot quarantine protocol upon failure of any critical safety test
